name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's path to motorsports wasn't typical. After earning a business degree from McGill, he spent several years in human resources for a large tech company. He found the corporate environment stifling, and a lifelong passion for racing finally drove him to pursue a career change. He started by volunteering at local races, networking relentlessly until he landed a junior HR role with a smaller racing team. 

Jean-Pierre believes in building strong relationships with team members and fostering a positive and productive work environment. He's known for his innovative approaches to recruitment and retention, always looking for ways to attract top talent and keep them engaged. His calm demeanor and strategic thinking make him an invaluable asset to Hitech GP, especially during the pressures of a race season.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Jean-Pierre has a friendly face and a warm, approachable presence.

quirks: Always has a motivational quote of the day on his desk.
Prefers to conduct interviews while walking around the office.
Secretly critiques the ergonomics of everyone's workstation.
